text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day has finally come for the classic race that decides the Ruler of the Mile—the NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With over a hundred thousand viewers gathered, the atmopshere is completely different.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-what's happening?! All the precious Umas appear so poised to slay on today's racecourse! What have I done to deserve this experience?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's incredible! It's divine! I so don't belong here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nevertheless, inadequate as I may be, the exhilarating rush from experiencing this firsthand is—hrgnkh! My heart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: At this point, I couldn't say one way or another. Being here surrounded by all these talented Umas… It's like a dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Here I am, at last, witnessing the beauty and awe of the whole scene in such high resolution…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But I want to find it. I have to find it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I have to get to the bottom of what makes Umamusume so blessed and find exactly where their sparkle comes from!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Even if it means I must be purified in their divine aura.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Was somebody watching me just now? I've got this tickling sense that someone's nearby…
choice_data_list: It doesn't seem like anyone's staring at you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Really? As unbelievable as it may seem, it felt like… in the midst of my simping, I myself was being simped…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait! I can't afford to be distracted!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Today is the day I must discover the secret to Umamusume glory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a race this big, the competition is bound to be top-notch. Sensing something from the impressive lineup of first-rate runners, this all-rounder gears up to show what she's got.
